description:
## [1.2.0-dev.1](https://github.com/logm1lo/logm1lo-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0-dev.1) (2026-09-10)

* **calistree:** support 5.9.1 - versioned Dart hex tables + stdlib reshift ([21d3ac5](https://github.com/logm1lo/logm1lo-patches/commit/21d3ac584bc1020e50a1aa6c2b5efdbf9141a72b))

patches.name: Feed file browser data (extension)
patches.description: Self-heals the empty file browser by listing the real filesystem into the active file source on first access.

patches.name: Feed slide-panel file list (extension)
patches.description: Seeds the visible file browser's tab getters with the real directory listing via the MtTools extension, so the slide panel renders all files instead of only the breadcrumb.

patches.name: Fix account map getter
patches.description: Makes l.ۨ᩸ܰ.۟()Ljava/util/Map; return an empty HashMap instead of null to prevent Purchase-VIP / account screen crashes.

patches.name: Fix file listing (direct FileSource)
patches.description: Forces the node-factory mount check and node validation to pass so folders and file pickers populate.

patches.name: Fix file-browser click (fed list)
patches.description: Makes the file-browser onItemClick read the fed file list (l/ۤۚܳ.᩷()) instead of the stale warm-state list, fixing IndexOutOfBounds on row clicks.

patches.name: Fix file-browser pane geometry (full height + no shift)
patches.description: Makes l.ۗ᩺ܰ measure the pane at full available height and never translate it down, so all file rows render and scroll.

patches.name: Fix file-browser pane visibility
patches.description: Forces l.ۗ᩺ܰ.addView to keep pane children VISIBLE so the file list renders.

patches.name: Fix file-browser status counter (self-feeding)
patches.description: Rebuilds l.ۤۚܳ.᩷() to return the real file list (native warm state) or feed real items via the MtTools extension on fresh installs, never NPEing the browser.

patches.name: Fix two-pane row text width (expanded rows)
patches.description: Forces l.۠᩺ܳ rows to stay in the complex measure branch so file names and sub-text render instead of being 0-width.

patches.name: Fix VIP list variant
patches.description: Makes l.᩷ۛܰ.ܿ() (VIP file-list variant) delegate to the working normal variant so ۘ()=true keeps file listing intact.

patches.name: Force file-browser ListView to draw rows (real target)
patches.description: Replaces l.ܳۚܰ.draw with a plain super call so the file browser's ListView always paints its rows.

patches.name: Force file-browser ListView to layout rows
patches.description: Replaces l.ܳۚܰ.layoutChildren with a plain super call so the file browser's ListView lays out all its rows.

patches.name: Force file-browser pane to draw rows
patches.description: Replaces l.֡ۚܰ.dispatchDraw with a plain super call so the visible file list always paints its rows.

patches.name: Force User Agreement accepted
patches.description: Makes l.۬۟᩶.getBoolean return true for the user_agreement key so the EULA never re-shows.

patches.name: Login removal / bypass
patches.description: Makes the app think you are logged into an MT account.

patches.name: Neutralize anti-tamper
patches.description: Removes the RuntimeException self-verification throws in Main.<init>/onCreate.

patches.name: Patch native keys
patches.description: Stubs K2M7 <clinit> canaries and patches the 39 native XOR keys / 12 bool flags to constants.

patches.name: Reimplement native tools (extension)
patches.description: Reroutes Dex2Smali / Dex2Jar / Sign to pure-Java reimplementations bundled in the mtmanager extension.

patches.name: Stub native methods
patches.description: Replaces all l.* native methods with safe Java defaults so the app no longer depends on native registration.

patches.name: Unlock VIP
patches.description: Unlocks VIP features (FTP/SFTP/SMB/WebDav, MT_Protector, themes).

patches.name: Unlock VIP (methods)
patches.description: Replaces all seven VIP getter methods on l.ۨ᩸ܰ to always return true.

patches.name: Unlock VIP (wrappers)
patches.description: Forces the four pure-Java VIP wrapper methods (l/ܽۜ.᩷ۢ᩶, l/ᩴ᩶.۫ۨۢ, l/᩵᩶.۠֫ۧ, l/᩸ۗ.᩹֡۫) to return true — splice-safe (no native methods touched).

patches.name: Dart Pro gates (libapp.so)
patches.description: Applies the 10 Dart AOT hex patches to libapp.so that unlock the native Pro gates.

patches.name: Premium Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks all Calistree PRO features.

patches.name: Puzzles Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks all puzzles.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes ads.

patches.name: Unlock Locket Gold
patches.description: Unlocks Locket Gold by forcing the internal android_gold_subscription_override flag to true.
